messages:
Rachel Gomez: Hey folks! Im Rachel, starting today on Solutions Engineering. Remote from Oakland but Ill be in the SF office twice a month. Im into late-night sudoku, cold brew experiments, and tiny desk succulents. :)
Omar Ziad: Welcome Rachel!! :tada: Sudoku + succulents = champion combo. What difficulty do you like?
Rachel Gomez: Thanks Omar! I do the medium/easy Sunday puzzles, terrible at the Sunday monster kind. Also curious about lunch options nearby and whether people share cold brew makers in the kitchen.
Lina Park: Hi Rachel  welcome! We have a shared cold-brew carafe in the fridge, label your jar. For lunches, the food truck near the dock does good bowls and theres a salad spot two blocks over.
Ben Rogers: FYI badge lockers are row C (combos usually start with 7). Theres a community shelf for plants and small knickknacks if you want to swap your succulents.
Rachel Gomez: Awesome, will bring a tiny pot of sedum to swap. Quick poll: rooftop hang Friday 6pm  :sun_with_face: for rooftop or :house: for indoor lounge? React with emoji.
Omar Ziad: :sun_with_face: rooftop for me. Ill bring a small travel-sized cold brew press.
Lina Park: :house: Im on childcare duty but can drop by earlier.
welcome-bot: Welcome message posted to #new-hires: "Say hi to Rachel Gomez  Solutions Engineering  Oakland/SF" :wave:
Rachel Gomez: Thanks everyone  excited to meet folks (and trade sudoku tips).
